# San Kala

> AI researcher at eBay. Research, writing, films, and interactive experiments.

## Complete writing

- [It's just possible](https://www.sankala.me/notes/its-just-possible.md): Complete Markdown mirror. October 2026. How San steered a fleet of AI agents to #1 on both tracks of the NeurIPS 2026 RealPDE competition's development phase while flying to IROS; also the IROS origami final and the Tartan IMU Challenge, with a short guide.
- [Nobody Owes Anything Now](https://www.sankala.me/notes/nobody-owes-anything-now.md): A poem, October 2026. Complete text. A potter in an O’Neill cylinder, after AI made money stop mattering; the page has a sgraffito cup turning on a wheel.
- [GPT-7 Will Have Arms](https://www.sankala.me/essays/gpt7-will-have-arms.md): Complete Markdown mirror. Original forecast: December 2025. Film adaptation: September 2026.
- [Winning by Overfitting](https://www.sankala.me/notes/eai-challenge.md): Complete account of the NeurIPS 2025 EAI Challenge at the FMEA Workshop, written July 2026.
- [Glyp: A Post-Mortem](https://www.sankala.me/notes/startr-postmortem): Personal note on the StartR accelerator startup, December 2025; original pitch October 2023. Includes a board-game figure whose cards quote the essay.
- [ZINify](https://www.sankala.me/notes/zinify.md): Complete Markdown mirror. Turning research papers into zines with Jaidev Shriram, UIST 2023 Honorable Mention; with a photocopier figure.
- [Recognizing electrical disturbances with neural networks](https://www.sankala.me/notes/power-quality.md): Complete Markdown mirror. The 2019 IEEE DISCOVER Best Paper on power-quality events with LSTMs; with an oscilloscope figure.
